title: ui-prompt: compose PromptPhase component
description: Compose the PromptPhase component that integrates the textarea, scaffolding buttons, and ExtractFieldsButton into a cohesive prompt input interface. This component orchestrates the layout and interaction between all prompt-related UI elements.

THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain proper tab order for accessibility

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL enable the continue action

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render with broken layout

unwanted.condition: IF a child component throws an error

happy: Render PromptPhase and verify all child components appear correctly
